kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
يحتضروا (form VIII)
# يَحْتَضِرُوا (yaḥtaḍirū) /jaħ.ta.dˤi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara)
# يُحْتَضَرُوا (yuḥtaḍarū) /juħ.ta.dˤa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara) and اُحْتُضِرَ (uḥtuḍira)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
